chunks: And from him, from Mu'awiya ibn Hakam, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: 'Adhere to those who are fertile (have broad hips/womb), for they are the most fertile.'

key_terms.أَنْجَبُ: More fertile; comparative adjective indicating greater capacity for childbirth
key_terms.ذَوَاتِ الْأَوْرَاكِ: Those with broad hips/wombs; a term indicating fertility and physical capacity for bearing children

ai.seo_question: What physical characteristic does the Imam recommend looking for in a spouse to ensure fertility?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights ذوات الأوراك (those with broad hips or prominent hip bones) as a sign of superior fertility, reflecting the classical medical understanding of his time that physical structure correlates with reproductive capacity. This advice underscores the Shia emphasis on procreation and the continuation of the lineage, linking physical suitability to the spiritual and social benefit of raising offspring within the faith.
